alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Data type {{DataType}} ingestion dropped {{DropPercent}} percent against its 7-day baseline of {{BaselineVolume}}.

properties.query:
Usage
| where IsBillable == true
| summarize CurrentVolume = sumif(Quantity, TimeGenerated > ago(1d)),
            BaselineVolume = sumif(Quantity, TimeGenerated between (ago(8d) .. ago(1d))) / 7.0
    by DataType
| where BaselineVolume > 10
| where CurrentVolume < (BaselineVolume * 0.5)
| extend DropPercent = round((1.0 - (CurrentVolume / BaselineVolume)) * 100, 1)
| project DataType, CurrentVolume = round(CurrentVolume, 2), BaselineVolume = round(BaselineVolume, 2), DropPercent
properties.displayName: Ops - Log Ingestion Volume Drop by Data Type
properties.description:
DETECTS
Any billable data type whose ingestion over the last day fell to less than half its trailing seven-day average.

WHY IT MATTERS
Catches the failure mode the Heartbeat rule cannot: the agent is alive and reporting, but a specific log stream has stopped. A deleted data collection rule, a broken connector, or a disabled audit policy silently removes an entire category of visibility while every host still looks healthy (MITRE T1562, Impair Defenses). Most SOCs discover this only when an investigation turns up no data.

TRIAGE
1. Identify which data type dropped and which detections depend on it. Consult the SOURCE section of the other rules in this workspace.
2. Determine whether a data connector, DCR, or diagnostic setting was recently changed. Correlate with the Sentinel configuration and diagnostic settings rules.
3. Establish whether the drop is environmental, such as decommissioned hosts or a genuine reduction in activity.
4. Check for a matching sampling or daily-cap event, which produces the same symptom for billing reasons.
5. Restore the pipeline and treat the gap period as unmonitored for that data type.

FALSE POSITIVES
Weekend and holiday troughs in business activity, planned decommissioning, and deliberate ingestion tuning. The 50 percent threshold against a 7-day mean is deliberately coarse and will need adjustment for data types with strong weekly seasonality.

SOURCE
Usage
